written_by: hand, from the RTL and the property text; never from sby output
step_rule: Measured on both open frontends (boundary probe in PROVENANCE.md): a property sby reports at step s samples the design at step s - 1, and $past(x, n) there reads step s - 1 - n. For s <= n that is before step 0, which no constraint covers.
timeline: cnt is 0 at step 0 and counts up by one per step (mod 8); top = (cnt == 7) holds at steps 7, 15, ... f_age is 0, 1, 2 at steps 0 to 2 and 3 from step 3 on. So on a real trace $past(top, 3) is 1 at steps 10, 18, ..., where cnt == 2.

builtin_cover.why: Same covers as slang_cover, as labelled immediate covers in a clocked always block; the built-in frontend samples them on the same edge and keeps a statement label as the property name.

slang_cover.why: c_footgun needs top three steps before a step where cnt == 1, but top is 1 only where cnt == 7, three steps before cnt == 2: on a real trace it is unreachable. Sampled at step 1 (reported at step 2), $past(top, 3) reads step -2, so it is reached there on a trace where top is never 1. c_unguarded is reachable for real at step 11, but sampled at step 2 (reported 3) $past(top, 3) reads step -1, so it is first reached there, before any real witness. c_guarded is the correctly constrained variant: f_age == 3 holds only from step 3, when the $past chain has filled, so its first witness is the real one, sampled at step 10 and reported at step 11.

slang_bmc.why: a_footgun is the assertion form of c_footgun: on a real trace it holds, but sampled at step 1 (reported at step 2) its $past(top, 3) reads step -2, which the solver may set to 1, so BMC reports a counterexample at step 2 on a trace where top is never 1. The covers are not checked in bmc mode.
